title: 資料串流處理平台
summary: 以事件時間、分區日誌與檢查點連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect event time, partition logs and checkpoints through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 事件與分區
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「事件與分區」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop events and partitions through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 事件 schema：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「事件 schema」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for event schema.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「事件 schema」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料格式演進需維持消費者相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較新增選填與改型別。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for event schema. Schema evolution preserves consumer compatibility. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare optional additions and type changes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較新增選填與改型別。
steps.observationEn: Compare optional additions and type changes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有分區 offset 能建立全域事件時間。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Offsets across partitions establish global event time. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「事件 schema」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「資料格式演進需維持消費者相容。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit event schema two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 事件 schema的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 資料格式演進需維持消費者相容。

knowledge.title: 事件 schema的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較新增選填與改型別。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare optional additions and type changes. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設每秒 50,000 筆事件、每筆 400 B：原始流量=20 MB/s。保留 24 h=1.728 TB，三份複本=5.184 TB，未計壓縮、索引、重試與編碼。晚到容許 10 s 不代表所有事件準時。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 50,000 events/s at 400 B/event: 20 MB/s raw traffic, 1.728 TB over 24 h and 5.184 TB for three replicas, excluding compression, indexes, retries and encoding. A 10 s lateness allowance does not ensure timely arrivals.

quiz.question: 本步審查「事件 schema」與整體「資料串流處理平台」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing event schema within data-stream processing platforms, which statement or check is supported?
options: 資料格式演進需維持消費者相容。
所有分區 offset 能建立全域事件時間。
Exactly-once 處理自動保證所有外部副作用一次。
optionsEn: Schema evolution preserves consumer compatibility.
Offsets across partitions establish global event time.
Exactly-once processing guarantees every external effect once.
quiz.explanation: 資料格式演進需維持消費者相容。 比較新增選填與改型別。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Schema evolution preserves consumer compatibility. Compare optional additions and type changes. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 事件 schema：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「比較新增選填與改型別。」檢查「事件 schema」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for event schema using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「事件 schema」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較新增選填與改型別。 核對「資料格式演進需維持消費者相容。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for event schema and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare optional additions and type changes. Check the principle: Schema evolution preserves consumer compatibility. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較新增選填與改型別。
steps.observationEn: Compare optional additions and type changes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有分區 offset 能建立全域事件時間。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Offsets across partitions establish global event time. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「事件 schema」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較新增選填與改型別。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit event schema input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.objective: 以「消費者群組」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for consumer groups.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「消費者群組」的資料、控制與時間關係。分區分配限定同群組的平行度。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較分區與 consumer 數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for consumer groups. Partition assignment bounds group parallelism. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare partition and consumer counts. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較分區與 consumer 數。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Exactly-once 處理自動保證所有外部副作用一次。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Exactly-once processing guarantees every external effect once. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「消費者群組」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「分區分配限定同群組的平行度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit consumer groups two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 消費者群組的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 分區分配限定同群組的平行度。

knowledge.title: 消費者群組的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較分區與 consumer 數。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare partition and consumer counts. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「消費者群組」與整體「資料串流處理平台」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing consumer groups within data-stream processing platforms, which statement or check is supported?
options: 分區分配限定同群組的平行度。
所有分區 offset 能建立全域事件時間。
Exactly-once 處理自動保證所有外部副作用一次。
optionsEn: Partition assignment bounds group parallelism.
Offsets across partitions establish global event time.
Exactly-once processing guarantees every external effect once.
quiz.explanation: 分區分配限定同群組的平行度。 比較分區與 consumer 數。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Partition assignment bounds group parallelism. Compare partition and consumer counts. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 消費者群組：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「比較分區與 consumer 數。」檢查「消費者群組」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for consumer groups using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「消費者群組」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較分區與 consumer 數。 核對「分區分配限定同群組的平行度。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for consumer groups and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare partition and consumer counts. Check the principle: Partition assignment bounds group parallelism. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較分區與 consumer 數。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Exactly-once 處理自動保證所有外部副作用一次。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Exactly-once processing guarantees every external effect once. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「消費者群組」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較分區與 consumer 數。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit consumer groups input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
